States mappings are suggestive, require detailed design, consultation, evaluation beyond paper's scope
Introduces Principle 3: Monitor Constraint Resonance, based on variance spike at τ=0.9 indicating synchronous layer activation
Proposes monitoring indicators at each layer (e.g., CMI>0.6, SRD, variance spikes) as research direction for early warning
Notes resonance monitoring is speculative, inferred from limited data, requires substantial research
Introduces Principle 4: Invest in Alignment Research Under Multi-Layer Paradigm, critiques current methodology assumptions
Urges investment in session-robust alignment, multi-stakeholder alignment, cross-layer guarantees, paradigms acknowledging Dual Unmappability
Affirms existing techniques like RLHF as achievements, but necessary yet insufficient; calls for expansion

Outlines future work: extend empirical validation across models/parameters/metrics, rigorous formalization, metric validation studies, case study generalization, regulatory feasibility
